title: Advanced Coaching Training| Deep Coaching for ICF-MCC & PCC Credential
description: Get your ICF-PCC or MCC credential and become a transformational coach through advanced coaching education. Start your ICF coaching education training with Coach Masters Academy’s program.
content:
Foundational Advantage Competency Advantage Mastery Advantage Collective Advantage Comparison Table

Competency Advantage Professional Certification Track

Everyone can support someone in a conversation. Now, you learn to coach the whole person.

Competency Advantage extends your foundational coaching mindset into advanced professional practice. You learn to engage the whole person — their concerns, values, tensions, and underlying assumptions - so that coaching conversations become spaces where their meaning-making can be seen, questioned, and re-organised.

Grounded in the ICF Core Competencies at the PCC level, you build the capability to respond fluidly rather than follow a script, creating richer, more finely attuned conversations that enable people to change how they see themselves and what they are facing.

This Advantage consolidates your existing strengths into a reliable practice you can draw on when conversations are complex or emotionally charged. Through a focused sequence of labs and mentoring, you refine a way of working you can trust in high-stakes situations and grow into a practitioner whose work carries weight in demanding environments.

Deeper Impact - hold more spacious dialogues where people can work through what truly drives their choices and behaviour.

Shareper Thinking - see what is happening beneath the surface in real time and shape your responses with precision.

Stronger Position - grow your practice against a recognised global benchmark so organisations, clients, and peers trust the quality of your work.

Impactful coaching is about engaging reflectively - enabling insight to emerge, awareness to expand, and to build forward momentum - all in service of meaningful change.

Program Snapshot

Who it's for: People new to coaching, or leaders who want stronger coaching skills in their role.

Time commitment: About 80 learning hours over approximately 24 weeks.

Certification Pathway: This program provides an upgrade to the ICF Level 2 if you have completed an ICF Level 1 Accredited or ACSTH Program, and this meets the requirement for the PCC Credential.

Program Structure

  • Learning Lab :10 Sessions
  • Competency Lab :10 Sessions
  • Practical Lab :12 Sessions
  • Enrichment Lab :3 Sessions
  • Mentoring Lab :3 Sessions
  • Engagement Lab :2 Sessions

Program Description

Learning Lab: Understanding What You Are Working With

This is where you stop guessing why conversations stall, loop in circles, or suddenly go flat. You learn to read the inner logic behind what people say and do in real time. You begin to see the beliefs, values, tensions, and unspoken commitments that quietly organise their reactions.

Drawing on research into how adults make sense of their world, you turn that awareness into a precise coaching skill. You learn to name what is really at stake, focus the conversation where it matters most, and invite clients into clearer, braver choices that fit who they are and what they care about.

Part 1: Seeing the Person Behind the Story

In this module, you learn to listen at the level of sense-making. You begin to notice how a person is constructing their reality in the moment: what they highlight, what they leave out, and what their words reveal about what is at stake for them. We name this stance “I See You" because your listening goes beyond the story to the person trying to make sense of their world. You study how attention, interpretation, and emotion work together as a system, and you practise using this understanding in live dialogue. As your listening becomes more precise, you frame what the client is really working through, reflect the essence of their experience, and create the felt impact of being accurately seen.

 Key Insights You Will Explore

  • How words, tone, and focus reveal what people are really working out beneath the surface.
  • How to separate story detail from the core issue, so you can reflect what genuinely matters to them.
  • How to test and refine your understanding in the moment, so “I See You" feels accurate and respectful.
  • How listening at the level of sense-making sharpens your questions and deepens the impact of each conversation.
Part 2: Facilitating Clarity

Some experiences are hard to put into words. In this module, you learn how to work with those moments. You explore how Clean & Metaphorical Language can open thinking when ordinary questions reach their limit.

Clean Language gives you a disciplined way to stay inside the client's own words while directing attention to the places their mind has not yet gone. You pair this with a practical understanding of how inquiry shapes attention and thinking, so your questions genuinely evoke awareness rather than lead or interpret. These advanced tools add a new dimension to your practice and significantly strengthen your capacity to Evoke Awareness at a PCC level.

 Key Insights You Will Explore

  • How Clean Language questions keep your language aligned with the client's words while guiding attention to what matters most.
  • How to work with client-generated metaphors to reveal and explore complex inner experiences that are difficult to express directly.
  • How to construct questions that slow thinking down, reveal new connections, and support clearer, more coherent decisions.
  • How integrating clean questions and metaphorical exploration creates breakthrough moments of understanding in coaching conversations.
Competency Lab: Knowing What It Looks Like in Practice

This is where the ICF Core Competencies shift from a checklist on paper to a coherent way of coaching. You learn to express the competencies through how you relate, listen, and respond, so you show up more deliberate and grounded, and the PCC markers begin to appear naturally rather than mechanically. Using CMA's framework, you work with the PCC markers in a structured, rigorous way. You clarify what each marker is intended to do, see how it changes the depth and feel of a session, and apply it to real cases with clear guidance and feedback. Many practitioners experience this Lab as a turning point: the design drives accelerated growth and visible breakthroughs in your ability to coach at a globally recognised standard of depth, rigour, and professionalism.

 Learning Highlights

  • Study the ICF Core Competencies and PCC markers as an integrated system shaping the whole coaching conversation.
  • Practise demonstrating the markers in real and simulated cases, so the competencies become a natural expression of your style.
  • Use structured self-review and targeted feedback to refine specific markers while staying present and fluid with your client.
  • Build confidence to live out the competencies with clarity and ease, without trying to recall them during a session.
Practical Lab & Enrichment Lab: Learning by Doing & Observing

This is where you build the confidence to use and adapt it in your real-life context.

Practical Lab: Applying the Approach in Real Conversations
In the Practical Lab, you put the approach into practice through real conversations and structured case studies. You see how the method actually unfolds in practice, build confidence using it in your own context, and receive guidance from an experienced coach supervisor. This helps you link the concepts to live coaching moments and notice the subtleties in coach–client interactions.

Enrichment Lab: Witnessing Mastery in Action
In the Enrichment Lab, you have the rare opportunity to watch mastery in action. You observe the same approach applied at a highly skilled level in a real conversation, with space to reflect on what you are seeing. This gives you a clear picture of how the method works when executed well, and a concrete sense of what to aim for as your own practice grows.

Mentoring Lab: Seeing What You Couldn't See Alone

In the Mentoring Lab, you receive focused feedback on your coaching conversations. Your mentor helps you notice what you did well, what you missed, and how your way of thinking shapes your questions and responses. This kind of guided reflection strengthens your awareness and supports progress that is hard to achieve on your own.

title: Advance Training for Mastery Coaching-Coach Masters Academy
content:
All too often, our authenticity and potential are obscured by our conditioning - limiting beliefs, distorted perspectives, and reactive feelings can fuel a sense of struggle and prevent us from being who we are. 

Building on the Awareness-Clarity-Choice Conversation, the Advanced Training will accelerate your competency to create a more meaningful and deep conversation.

You can step outside your comfort zone and challenge yourself to stretch beyond the learned techniques to embrace mastery coaching as an art.

From this place, you can co-create authentic change with your clients. 

How does this advanced training support you in mastery coaching?

The most effective way to experience sustainable transformation (deep and lasting change) is from the inside out. This challenges coaches to develop a strong connection and grounded presence with their clients to draw from within. This is a sacred moment of awakening and growth in which clients can access their innate capacity to live an authentic life in which they are emotionally engaged, courageous, and empowered.

Designed for advanced development, you will learn how transformative moments unfold and deepen the learning for clients.

You will also learn to facilitate and navigate a dynamic coaching process that invites change.

Find out what our graduates say about how the training has accelerated their coaching competencies.

Learn More

How this program is structured

Designed to accelerate your skills to mastery level, the Advanced Training for Mastery Coaching comprises four pillars of targeted learning, namely (1) Learning Lab, (2) Practical Lab, (3) Peer to Peer Practice, and (4) Supervised Practical Coaching.

  •   Learning Lab

    Module A: Co-Creating Authentic Change

    Nurture thinking and making it visible is at the core of this module. It examines how meaning is constructed in parts forming the whole. You will develop advanced competence in attending and responding and expanding your listening capacity.

    Module B: Personal Mastery

    This module lays the foundation for creating profound transformation for the client. You will be guided on directing your awareness inward to focus on the present moment. This state allows us to suspend our agendas and judgments and witness the experience as it unfolds. 

    Module C: Facilitating Clarity

    The clean and Metaphorical Language process enables clients to discover more about their inner world and how they construct meaning. It will allow participants to explore the power of clean language metaphors and practice specific ways to use them effectively in the coaching conversation.

  •   Practical Lab

    Using a structured framework, you will understand the benchmark to demonstrate your coaching competency at the PCC skillset. 

  •   Peer-to-Peer Practice

    You can integrate your learning and practice your skills in a safe learning environment with your peers, supported by student mentors who graduate from the academy. This platform will provide rich interaction and learning from the diverse backgrounds and cultures within the group.

  •   Coaching Supervision

    Supervised practical coaching aims to integrate your classroom learning into real-life situations. This learning is two-fold; you demonstrate coaching at the advanced level and gain a complete understanding of the PCC marker. These practical coaching sessions will be conducted via an online platform. This is one of the most effective ways to isolate other modalities and assess the participant’s learning while improving listening skills. Students experience significant improvements in their coaching skills in the latter part of the face-to-face coaching sessions.

How does this advanced training support you in mastery coaching?

To complete the training and meet the ICF requirements, you will need to: ● Complete the Pre-Course Reading Assignments ● Maintain 70% attendance for the Learning and Practical Labs * ● Attend 12 Supervised Practical Coaching ● Complete 3 PCC Marker Assessments ● Submit 1 Research Paper ● Submit 2 Recording demonstrating PCC level of coaching * For sessions you miss, you need to preview the lesson and submit a brief learning summary of 300 words.

title: Advancing Human Potential-Coach Masters Academy
content:
Advancing Potential using a transformational coaching approach

We are designed to grow and develop; however, many variables impact whether we live up to their potential, such as the necessary beliefs, perspectives, self-awareness, motivation, grits, role models, learning agility and professional support, to name a few. Without new learning and support, one would face many insurmountable obstacles that may result in ineffective personal development.

Professional coaching helps advance human potential because it focuses on positive forward action. It doesn’t dwell on the current situation any more than is necessary to understand it. It also doesn’t dredge through the past with a view to ‘fixing’ it. It merely draws from the client’s past experiences in order to identify and find those elements that will form a necessary part of the solution, most notably in the form of a new understanding or interpretation of the current situation.

Professional coaching contributes to advancing human potential because it begins from a deep-seated belief that humans have potential and that this potential can be advanced.

Transformative coaching does not focus on fixing the immediate problem by offering a tactical problem-solving solution to the challenge. 

It provides a platform for people to develop the necessary understanding of their underlying values and beliefs to formulate the required solutions on their own, not only to solve the problem but also to similar problems in the future.

Making changes is not difficult, but making changes last is. 

The human mind is complex. It is filled with the knowledge we have learned, the emotions that we feel, the memories we have made, and the values and beliefs that we hold. This web of ‘thinking’ is what constitutes the human experience. Unfortunately, nobody teaches us how to make sense of how we relate to our reality or uncover what matters most. 

This is what sets our transformational approach apart from conventional coaching methodology.

We focus on constructively leveraging the human experience in order to better understand your reality, enabling you to make better, more informed decisions as a result.

Coaching for action or coaching for change?

Conventional coaching focuses on helping people to achieve improvements by drawing out strengths and bypassing personal barriers and limits. This involves promoting the development of behavioural competence through observation and feedback. Often advice, guidance or opinions are offered based on a shallow understanding of the issues. This can be useful when the goal is to achieve a short-term or immediate result but is not helpful in achieving true transformation. 

Professional coaching contributes to advancing human potential because it begins from a deep-seated belief that humans have potential and that this potential can be advanced.

title: Article Interview with our Founder - Understanding the uniqueness of CMA Transformative Coaching-Coach Masters Academy
content:
Article Interview with our Founder - Understanding the uniqueness of CMA Transformative Coaching

"Awaken the Potential WITHIN through transformative coaching" by Smart Investor. The Chief Editor of Smart Investor catches up with our Founder, Ben Koh an ICF Master Certified Coach (MCC) on his vision to become the catalyst to transform organisation and people through transformative coaching.

Attending the coaching course conducted by Master Certified Coach and Mentor Coach, Ben Koh, has been a rewarding experience. During the 4-days intensive “Transformative Coaching” course held in Kuala Lumpur, June 2016, Ben shared his knowledge with would-be and existing coaches to enhance their skills in creating transformative and more sustainable change in their clients.

Unlike a consultant or a mentor, the coach is not an expert in the client’s field. Instead, a coach’s role is to help his clients have a higher thinking capacity to reflect on their issues rather than expand their skills to do the job better. “ The environment is always changing and therefore can be quite frustrating. Negative emotions if left unchecked can limit people in decisions and choices that are made, ” says Ben.

The Master Coach who has over 17 years of experience across 17 countries in Asia, explains that his coaching framework integrates the science of Emotional Intelligence and Positive Psychology approach to enhance the learning ability to become a coach. It emphasises awareness and clarity and in that heightened state of consciousness, one will be able to look deeper and realise his real internal desires. He will then be able to create solutions that are sustainable when he is able to align his actions to his real intention, according to Ben.

One of the things that coaching does is to stimulate thinking and understanding to help the client to be a better thinker- not just thinking for a solution but the ability to think through the situation, he adds.

Smart Investor (SI): Can you share with us what make Coach Master Academy unqiue or the most trusted coach academy?

Ben Koh (BK): Coach Mastery Academy is an academy but it is more of an academy that is propelled by a vision to inspire positive change through mastery coaching. We have an in-house coaching proprietary framework - Awareness, Clarity & Choice Conversation that is based on an empirical approach to effect change. The change that we want is sustainable change.

What will make change sustainable depends on how the coach shows up during the coaching conversation. One of the hallmarks is being present in the moment – meaning that the coach is aware and able to notice how his own thoughts are influencing the way he communicates with his client, so that he is more mindful in his choice of words. In being present, the second key skill is really the way you listen: how you listen and what are you listening for.

This is vital to enable change because for many people, their intentions are being buried or distracted by the circumstances in life and they end up with responding to pressing needs or just to accomplish their duties. Through the alignment, we help them to be courageous and bold to their commitment to achieving their goals.

SI: How can coaching contribute to effective leadership that will benefit the organisation?

BK: Leaders are expensive because they are the people that think for the company. They need someone to talk through their thought processes - what are the things that they know that they did not know yet that they need to know; and what are the things that they know and need to do more of; and what are the things that are holding them back that they did not know.

What is holding them back or what is causing them to be stuck and not escalating upwards to be effective? In most cases, it is not a functional gap, as they have the experience and knowledge to do the role very well. But there is something else that is limiting them - and one of the things we noted is the way they interpret the situation, the way they integrate the situation and how they are being reactive.

These are not gaps but these are awareness. Coaching helps to heighten their own awareness to use their own wisdom to be adaptive, to evolve, and to create a different way of managing the same things better. This is very different from the logical thinking process of analysing, troubleshooting and reasoning, where the motive is to improve the situation.

They need to engage in reflective learning thinking process like  connecting, synthesising, linking - these are thinking process that stimulate deep learning. And when leaders are able to think in this manner, where we trust that they have enough experience, skills and resources, the organisation will then be able to leverage on them to give a better outcome.

SI: How can coaching help the leaders align to the organisation’s goal?

BK: There is a myth that coaching is for personal development. That is only partly true. Coaching as an industry has a high commitment to the stakeholder because it is a service industry. The coach has a strong obligation to the stakeholder who pays the money - to deliver the result for the stakeholder, that is, to align its people to the organisational goal.

The first thing is the client (the person being sponsored) must have the awareness in term of his alignment to that company’s goal and what is keeping him in the current level of reference.

And the beauty of transformative coaching is once you know what is holding you at the current level, we then turn the conversation and ask the client what can you learn from this experience about yourself at this current situation in terms of what your value is, in terms of what drives you, what is important, in terms of who you are and what it tells you about that.

Once the client is aware of his own internal motivation, therefore in moving forward, he can then adjust that motivation to be more aligned with the organisation goal. If the client is not aware of his own motivation, we cannot ask them to do things to get them to meet the organisation’s goal. That is just giving out instructions, where the change will not be sustainable.

CMA coaching philosophy begins with the fundamental principle that awareness is the first step to all change activity, and out of this awareness, you can then do the learning, out of learning  we can then co-create a more effective and impactful outcome.

SI: What are the changes you want to see in CMA graduates?

BK: Firstly, we want them to be a change agent that inspires positive and sustainable change. Secondly, because the vision is true for them, we want them to be fully committed to their learning as a coach because the impact that they deliver for the client will depend on how committed they are in continuing to sharpen the craft, the commitment to learning and constantly pushing themselves towards artfulness and mastery. This is vital because going forward, the economy is relying more and more on people’s potential.  And coaching is the right tool to help the economy to achieve that.

content:
A Complete Guide to ICF Certification with Coach Masters Academy

13 Nov

A Complete Guide to ICF Certification with Coach Masters Academy

Over the years, people worldwide have started realizing the transformative power of coaching. As a result, not only are more individuals seeking coaching to achieve a goal in their lives, but many are also looking to build their careers in the profession. Many aspirants are willing to learn coaching, specifically the certification process offered by the International Coaching Federation (ICF).

However, with overwhelming information available online, it is easy to be misguided. So if you are a coach aspirant, seeking the most accurate and relevant information, it’s important to understand the role of the International Coaching Federation (ICF). The ICF is the leading governing body for coaches and coaching training providers and sets industry standards for certification.

The ICF offers three coaching credentials: Associate Certified Coach (ACC), Professional Certified Coach (PCC), and Master Certified Coach (MCC). While it is important to note that the ICF doesn’t offer training programs directly, it certifies programs that meet their rigorous criteria. This is where Coach Masters Academy comes in.

Coach Masters Academy provides ICF-accredited coaching training programs that prepare you to meet the requirements for the coaching credentials. Whether you are just starting your coaching career or want to advance to the next level, CMA’s coaching programs ensure you receive the highest-quality education needed to earn an ICF credential.

Why CMA’s ICF-accredited Coaching Courses

What sets Coach Masters Academy (CMA) apart is our ICF-accredited training that integrates a proprietary coaching approach designed for transformative change. It includes a unique Awareness-Clarity-Choice Conversation framework, which goes beyond traditional coaching methods, enabling coaches to facilitate deep, meaningful transformation in their clients.

By combining this powerful framework with ICF-approved standards, CMA ensures that the training meets the rigorous certification requirements while equipping you with the necessary skills to create a sustainable impact in your coaching practice. This blend of high-quality education and transformative methodology makes CMA the ideal choice for anyone seeking to master their coaching career.

Now, let’s dive deeper to understand each ICF coaching certificate and ways to achieve it.

1.   Associate Coaching Certification Program (ACC)

The Associate Coaching Certification (ACC) Program is similar to earning an associate degree—offering a solid base in coaching. Having this certification, you obtain essential coaching tools that can open doors in both your personal and professional life.

Coach Masters Academy (CMA) offers a flexible, ICF-accredited coaching training program to help you achieve this. The core training spans 70 hours and is available in both online and blended formats. CMA’s structured 12-week online program offers flexibility and allows you to complete your training at your own pace. Once you finish the training, you can submit a recorded coaching session and pass an online test to finalize your ACC certification, setting the stage for your coaching career.

2.    Professional Coaching Certification Program (PCC)

If you want to take your coaching skills to the next level, earn a Professional Coaching Certification (PCC), which will solidify your status as a true professional. By earning a PCC credential, you not only demonstrate your commitment but also the expertise that you gained through comprehensive education and practice.

At CMA, the second-level advanced training for mastery coaching provides 80 hours of in-depth coach training, delivered entirely online for seven months. This program focuses on improving your coaching skills, enabling you to effectively guide your clients through meaningful transformations and deliver lasting change.

3.   Master Coaching Certification Program (MCC)

In the coaching industry, the Master Coaching Certification (MCC) is considered the gold standard and is for coaches seeking to master their skills and be recognized as experts.

CMA offers a third-level mastery training program, focusing on artful coaching. This program, which spans seven months with 80 hours of advanced training delivered 100% online, prepares you to become a true master in your field. Upon completion of this ICF coaching course, you become eligible to apply for the MCC credential through the ICF.

ICF Coaching Certification Training with Coach Masters Academy

At Coach Masters Academy (CMA), every step of your coaching education is designed to guide you toward achieving your certification goals while equipping you with the skills required for long-term success in the coaching industry. From the foundational ACC program to the advanced PCC and mastery-level MCC certifications, with CMA’s ICF-accredited coaching courses, you can get transformative and sustainable results at each stage of your journey.

Moreover, with a blend of innovative learning formats, practical experience, and CMA’s proprietary conversation framework, you can gain the tools to meet certification requirements and create lasting, transformative change in the lives of your clients. Whether you are just starting or want to advance to coaching mastery, CMA can support you at every step, preparing you for a rewarding and impactful coaching career.

content:
Become a Credentialed Coach with CMA’s ICF Coaching Training Online Program

9 Nov

Become a Credentialed Coach with CMA’s ICF Coaching Training Online Program

When it comes to personal and professional development, coaching stands out as one of the most essential tools. No matter you are looking to enhance your leadership skills, make a career shift into coaching, or support others in their growth, becoming an ICF-credentialed coach should be your next move. The International Coaching Federation (ICF) certification is widely recognized as a gold standard in the industry.

As an ICF-certified coach, you unlock the doors to work with individuals and organizations on a global scale. But there’s a defined path you need to follow to go from an aspiring coach to an ICF-certified professional.

If you seriously want to commit to coaching people, the first thing you need to do is sign up for an ICF-approved coaching training course- online or offline.

Coach Masters Academy (CMA) offers ICF coaching training online program that goes beyond traditional learning approaches, providing a transformational experience that focuses on sustainable change.

In this blog, we will guide you through the key steps involved in becoming an ICF-certified coach, and how CMA fulfills the criteria with the unique training approach.

Coach Masters Academy’s Proprietary Transformative Approach

When selecting an ICF certification training course online, you must pick a program that meets the ICF code of ethics while delivering training to create a real impact. Coach Masters Academy has become a leader in the field of coaching and is globally recognized for its proprietary transformative coaching approach.

While other programs teach the foundational aspects of coaching, CMA goes a step ahead by offering coaching training under the Awareness-Clarity-Choice Conversation framework, which empowers coaches to facilitate deep, sustainable change in their clients.

The Awareness-Clarity-Choice (ACC) conversation framework focuses on helping clients gain greater self-awareness, achieve clarity around their goals, and make conscious choices that lead to positive lasting change. This structured conversation framework is designed to move beyond surface-level coaching and encourage profound insights.

The ability to facilitate such a deep transformation sets CMA-trained coaches apart. With CMA, not only will you be equipped with the skills to guide your clients toward success but also with the mindset and tools to foster enduring change.

Steps to Become an ICF-Certified Coach

Now that you know the benefits of Coach Masters Academy’s transformative approach, let’s look at the steps toward achieving your ICF-coach credential.

1.   Sign Up for an ICF-Approved Coaching Training Program

Your journey begins with selecting the right ICF-approved training program. While there are many available, it’s important to choose one that aligns with your learning style and offers comprehensive training. Coach Masters Academy delivers top-notch ICF coaching training online, where you can receive a high standard of education from experienced instructors. Our online programs are designed to be flexible yet thorough, enabling you to balance your training with other life commitments.

2.   Complete 60+ Hours of Accredited Coach Training

To apply for an Associate Certified Coach (ACC) credential, you need to complete at least 60 hours of accredited coach-specific training. CMA’s ICF Core Training for Professional Coaching program of 70 hours duration meets this requirement while ensuring you are thoroughly prepared for both the practical and theoretical aspects of coaching. Their transformative approach equips you to handle real-world coaching scenarios with confidence.

3.   Engage in 10 Hours of Mentoring

Mentorship is a critical component of ICF certification. You are required to engage in a minimum of 10 hours of mentoring with an experienced ICF-certified coach. This mentorship helps refine your skills, deepen your understanding of core competencies, and receive constructive feedback. CMA integrates mentoring into its training programs, so you can seamlessly meet this requirement while continuing your education.

4.   Log 100 Hours of Coaching Practice

Practical experience is vital for building your coaching skills. As part of the certification process, you will need to log a minimum of 100 hours of coaching practice. CMA provides guidance on how to structure your practice sessions, ensuring that you are not only logging hours but also gaining meaningful experience that will help you grow as a coach.

5.   Apply with the ICF

Once you have completed your training, mentoring, and practice hours, you can submit your application to the ICF. You will need to provide your training certificate, proof of mentoring hours, and your coaching log. After applying, you will take a multiple-choice test that assesses your understanding of ICF’s core competencies. The training provided by CMA ensures that you are well-prepared for this final step.

ICF Coaching Training by Coach Masters Academy

Choosing the right ICF certification training course online can be a daunting task, but Coach Masters Academy simplifies your decision with the unique blend of ICF-accredited training and a transformational coaching approach. With our proprietary Awareness-Clarity-Choice conversation, you can learn how to create real, lasting change in your clients, which is critical to ensure your success as a coach.

The other factors that make CMA the leader in the coaching fraternity are the faculty members, comprising seasoned professionals with years of experience in coaching and mentoring. Our coaches provide you with invaluable insights and guidance that you remain instrumental throughout your coaching practice. Additionally, with flexible learning options, you can access high-quality ICF coaching training online from anywhere in the world.

Benefits You Can Achieve through Coach Masters Academy’s Leadership Development Program

20 Oct

Benefits You Can Achieve through Coach Masters Academy’s Leadership Development Program

In today’s competitive business landscape, leadership roles must go above and beyond to gain an edge over competitors and seize market opportunities. However, it takes a lot of effort to understand and adapt to the evolving market. That’s why, leaders and organizations are signing up for leadership skill training coaching.

Leadership coaching is one of the most successful methods for taking development to a deeper and more sustainable level, whether professional leadership coaching for individuals or offering coaching throughout your business.

Moreover, leadership coaching based on behavioral science is regarded as one of the most effective strategies to develop leaders and help them perform better. In this realm, Coach Masters Academy (CMA) stands out as a global leader offering top-tier leadership development coaching program for managers.

CMA’s Executive Leadership Coaching Program

CMA offers an Executive Leadership Coaching (ELC) program that focuses on high-impact leadership development. The ELC program uses a proprietary Awareness-Clarity-Choice (ACC) Conversation framework. This transformative coaching framework involves an empirical approach that draws on multiple disciplines, including the latest research in positive psychology and adult learning development.

The ACC Conversation framework is a unique conversation approach that evokes awareness, clarity, and understanding. The coaching process stimulates reflective thinking and expands awareness, enabling leaders to gain greater clarity about what motivates them to either engage or hold back.

With this transformational experience, leaders can tap into their potential and make empowering choices moving forward. If you are a leader wanting to hone your skills yourself or want to improve management and leadership at your organization, CMA’s ELC program is for you.

Here’s how CMA’s Executive Leadership Coaching Program takes your leadership capabilities to the next level.

Keeping High Potential at Peak Performance

While leaders are highly skilled and competent in their fields, they often encounter moments when the skills and strategies that once drove them to success are no longer adequate to meet new challenges. CMA’s Leadership Development Program for Managers addresses this issue by helping them generate new ideas, enrich their approaches, and develop fresh perspectives.

By signing up for CMA’s program, leaders or managers can achieve a higher level of performance, ensuring they remain adaptive, innovative, and capable of managing challenges in their evolving roles. The focus of the program is to support the ongoing growth of managers or leaders while helping them sustain optimum performance in demanding environments.

Leadership Transition or Onboarding

When leaders take on a new initiative or transition into more senior roles, especially, when moving from technical expertise to people leadership, they often need to develop new skills and grow in unfamiliar directions. This shift demands managing increased responsibilities and taking on a broader perspective that includes strategic thinking, team dynamics, and leadership development.

The ELC program is designed to support leaders during such critical transitions by equipping them with the tools and insights, required to navigate these changes effectively. It helps them enhance their leadership approach, enabling them to lead teams, manage complex situations, and inspire others while fostering a clear vision for organizational growth. With a focus on the challenges and opportunities that arise during such transitions, CMA’s ELC program ensures leaders are capable enough to succeed in their new roles.

Coaching Performance Issues

At times leaders hold onto their counterproductive habits or behaviors that limit their effectiveness and make them struggle to succeed. Those habits that may have worked in the past, can obstruct their ability to adapt to new challenges or lead more effectively in evolving environments. The transformational ELC program helps leaders identify these barriers and recognize where they could be wrong.

Through guided reflection and targeted feedback, CMA’s leadership development program for managers, enables them to shift their focus from past practices to present and future goals, fostering a deeper awareness of their strengths and areas for improvement. By cultivating this awareness and instilling a sense of personal responsibility, the ELC program encourages leaders to make meaningful changes in their behavior. This transformation not only enhances their leadership effectiveness but also positions them for sustainable success.

Conclusion

Coach Masters Academy’s Executive Leadership Coaching (ELC) program offers a comprehensive and transformative approach to leadership skills development training. Whether you are a seasoned leader seeking to hone your skills or stepping into a new leadership role, CMA’s ELC program equips you with the tools and insights necessary for sustainable growth. Based on the proprietary Awareness-Clarity-Choice (ACC) Conversation framework, the ELC program fosters self-awareness, adaptability, and strategic thinking. It empowers leaders to navigate challenges, inspire their teams, and consistently perform at their best. By fostering self-awareness.

How a Global Network of Coaches Can Take Your ICF Coaching Education to the Next Level

2 Dec

How a Global Network of Coaches Can Take Your ICF Coaching Education to the Next Level

If you are choosing coaching as your profession, you are starting on a rewarding journey that goes beyond a career. To get started with this truly worthwhile journey, you need to onboard the ICF coaching training course, offered online by Coach Masters Academy. It’s a path that opens doors to personal transformation and connects you to a worldwide network of like-minded, committed coaches. This global community enhances your learning experience, providing insights, support, and real-world perspectives that are crucial in the field of coaching.

When you sign up for CMA’s course, you don’t just receive a certification; you join a network dedicated to helping you achieve mastery through collaborative, science-backed coaching approaches.

The ICF Coaching Training Online program by CMA offers an advanced education that equips you to meet diverse coaching needs and empowers you to create meaningful, sustainable change for your clients. With a global network of coaches, CMA creates a unique learning environment that ensures you receive continuous support, practical learning opportunities, and lasting connections.

Why a Global Network is Crucial in Your ICF Coaching Education

In the coaching industry, differences in perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds can be incredibly valuable. As coaching is increasingly becoming a global profession, it’s essential to have access to a network that brings this diversity to a common platform. CMA has a global coaching community that connects coaches from different countries, cultures, and industries.

This diverse network allows you to gain valuable insights into coaching practices from around the world. This way, you can expand your cultural competency as well as adaptability, preparing you to work with clients from different backgrounds. Eventually, your coaching practice can turn more inclusive and effective.

There are many more benefits of learning coaching with a global network of coaches:

Enhanced Cultural Sensitivity: A global network exposes you to different cultural norms and perspectives. By learning how coaching is adapted across cultures, you develop the sensitivity needed to support clients with varied backgrounds.

Skill Development: Working with coaches from various fields and regions lets you see diverse coaching techniques in action. This diversity enriches your own toolkit and helps you adapt your approach to fit specific client needs.

Increased Problem-Solving Ability: Exposure to various coaching challenges and case studies sharpens your problem-solving skills. You gain insights into handling complex scenarios, boosting your confidence in diverse coaching environments.

Connect with Global Coaches through CMA’s ICF Coaching Training Course

When you choose CMA’s ICF Certification Training Course Online, you gain access to valuable resources and guidance from experienced coaches who help you understand the basics of coaching. The program offers an interactive learning experience that encourages discussions and collaboration within a global community, preparing you for real-world coaching situations.

Under the guidance of CMA’s experienced coaches, you gain insights into handling diverse situations, communicating effectively, and fostering meaningful change for clients. When you interact with this network, you become part of a community that holds you accountable and encourages you to reach your potential. Peers and mentors in this network provide both encouragement and constructive feedback, enabling you to tackle complex coaching challenges with confidence.

Whether you are looking to specialize in executive coaching, personal development, or any other niche, CMA’s network supports your goals and encourages you to develop a practice that is uniquely yours. Being part of this global community means you will always have access to diverse perspectives and evolving practices, which is invaluable in your coaching career.

What CMA Graduates Say

The words of appreciation by graduates speak volumes about CMA’s ICF coaching education. The following words state how the ICF certification training course online programs and the network of credentialed coaches open doors to a world of opportunities, learning, and connections.

“I enjoyed how the faculty team worked together to organize the program. I love the energy and warmth the faculty brings. Each person has a different technique yet is anchored on the same understanding of principles.”

“The program is well-structured and well-rehearsed, with different faculty contributing. After so much research over the internet, I am glad that I have made the right choice.”

These are just a few words quoted here. There are many more transformative journeys of coaches at CMA. Enrolling in CMA’s ICF coaching training online course means a lifelong journey of growth and development guided by the most experienced professionals in the industry. Through collaboration, mentorship, and continuous education, you will find that your journey with CMA is not just about becoming a coach but about transforming the lives of people for positive change.

content:
How CMA Prepares You to Create Real, Lasting Change Through Coaching

6 Nov

How CMA Prepares You to Create Real, Lasting Change Through Coaching

Coaching as a profession is considered the right fit for people passionate about helping others in moving out of distress or reach their full potential. Thus, they are often looked at to bring positive results that are deep-rooted and lasting- both at a personal or professional level. That said, a well-established coach doesn’t just simply serve the solutions on the plate but rather enables the clients to find solutions on their own.

However, if you want to become a professional coach and stand out from others in your approach, simply earning life coach certification won’t help much. You must think at an in-depth level and consider taking an ICF Coaching Certificate Program that is transformative in nature and delivers sustainable results.

Coach Masters Academy (CMA) is at the forefront of transformative learning and is committed to providing coaches with the highest quality ICF-approved Coaching Course. CMA’s proprietary transformative coaching framework, known as the Awareness-Clarity-Choice Conversation, integrates the science of positive psychology with the theories of transformative learning. It is designed to heighten awareness and deepen learning, creating a powerful shift in thinking to enable a positive change that is deep and sustainable.

CMA offers three distinctive levels of ICF-approved coaching certificate courses. Each program is designed to foster sustainable results. The evocative inside-out coaching approach enables coaches to reflect deeper and expand their thinking capacity to effect positive change beyond the situational or behavioral context.

Level 1 Coaching Training

This is the initial core training for professional coaching. It’s a 70-hour coach training course of 16 weeks duration that enables you to apply for ICF Membership and Credentials.

This course offers greater flexibility and convenience with a 100% online coach training format. It helps you build and improve your coaching effectiveness so you can effectively coach individuals or groups. Upon completion of the training, you will be awarded professional coaching certification that will allow you to build and improve your coaching effectiveness. Moreover, the proprietary coaching framework Awareness-Clarity-Choice Conversation makes you able t­o inspire positive change among your clients with small, decisive forward actions.

Level 2 Coaching Training

The second level of training, also known as Advanced Training for Mastery Coaching with seven months duration comprises 80 hours of coach training. This is delivered 100 percent online, completing which you will get Advance Professional Coach Certification, further enabling you to apply for the Professional Certified Coach (PCC) Credential.

Signing up for this advanced coach training course, you will be able to learn how the transformative moment unfolds and how you can use it artfully to facilitate and drive a dynamic coaching process that invites, evokes, and embraces change. The process honors what there already is while reaching deep within one’s consciousness to find what is emerging. This allows individuals to acquire a new perspective and see a different reality of how they experience the situation.

Level 3 Coaching Training

The third level in the coaching program is Mastery Training for Artful Coaching. This is for fully committed coaches seeking to deepen their understanding of the nature of the change to evoke a more profound transformational change through their practice. To become a professional coach you must acquire a deeper understanding of the coaching process to help clients make sense of the world around them.

The level 3 coaching training by CMA offers 80 hours of ICF-approved online coaching course spanning seven months duration and integrates the science of deep coaching within the ICF core competency for the (Master Certified Coach (MCC) level of coaching. This program also serves as a preparatory program for core competency development for mature coaches to evolve their skills from PCC to MCC level of coaching.

Final Thoughts!

Becoming a truly impactful coach requires more than just a certification; it demands a deep commitment to continuous learning and personal growth. Coach Masters Academy (CMA) provides an unparalleled pathway for coaches who are serious about creating real, lasting change. Through its comprehensive ICF-approved Coaching Courses, CMA equips you with the tools, insights, and techniques needed to guide clients toward profound transformation.

CMA’s transformative coaching approach ensures that you not only understand the science behind effective coaching but also embody it in your work. By choosing CMA, you are not just earning a credential, but joining a community of coaches dedicated to making a meaningful difference in the lives of others.

18 Oct

How CMA’s Mastery Training for Deep Coaching Prepares You for MCC Credentialing

The Master Certified Coach (MCC) credential is the highest level of certification a coach can earn from the International Coaching Federation (ICF).  Becoming an MCC is a rigorous journey wherein you need to acquire ICF’s Code of Ethics, Core Competencies, and well-refined coaching techniques.

It is not that master coaches solve any issues, but they help people, organizations, and coaches become their best versions. They offer tools to clients to recognize their own problems, inspect them, dissect them, and solve them in record time in a lasting way. Master Coaches are trained to shift the entire course of a person’s life, no matter who they are or where they come from.

To foster such a huge positive impact, you would need a deeper understanding of the coaching process and that you can learn with Coach Masters Academy (CMA).

Coach Masters Academy offers Mastery Training for Deep Coaching. This is an ICF-approved Level 3 coaching training program that not only prepares you for an MCC credential but also enables you to deepen your understanding of the nature of the change to evoke a profound transformation. Built on CMA’s proprietary Awareness-Clarity-Choice Conversation framework, this program prepares you to coach people for intentional change.

The MCC coaching training by CMA takes your coach training to the next level as it allows you to learn how the transformative moment unfolds and how to use it artfully in your coaching engagements.

Here are the benefits you can achieve with CMA’s MCC Training Program.

1.   The Awareness-Clarity-Choice (ACC) Framework

At the core of CMA’s Mastery Training is the proprietary Awareness-Clarity-Choice (ACC) Conversation framework. This scientific model helps coaches facilitate conversations that lead to deep self-awareness and transformative decision-making. As you master this framework, you will be able to guide clients through reflective processes that allow them to identify and resolve deeply rooted challenges.

The ACC framework is an essential tool that transforms the coaching process from simply addressing surface-level issues to creating intentional and sustainable change, helping you become a more impactful coach.

2.   Understanding of Transformative Change

To coach at the MCC level, it’s essential to deeply understand the psychology of change. MCC Coaching Training offers 80 hours of ICF-approved coaching education, where you will explore how change occurs on a fundamental level.

The course equips you to understand and apply theories of human behavior and consciousness shifts, enabling you to help clients move beyond their current limitations. By exploring how people experience profound shifts in thinking and perception, you will be able to evoke lasting, meaningful transformations.

3.   Preparation for MCC Credentialing

CMA’s Mastery Training for Deep Coaching meets the ICF Level 3 Accreditation requirements, comprising the competencies needed for the MCC credential application. If you are an established coach looking to elevate your skills from PCC to MCC, this training serves as an ideal preparatory program. CMA provides a structured learning path designed to enhance your coaching abilities, ensuring you are well-equipped to pass the rigorous MCC evaluation process. With specialized support from Master Coaches, you will learn to demonstrate MCC-level skills artfully.

4.   Flexible Learning Environment

The coaching training program by CMA is delivered 100% online, making it accessible to coaches worldwide. It is more than simple ZOOM virtual classes or webinars; it offers well-structured online coach training that is truly interactive and engaging. The course is well-structured and truly interactive as it focuses on live coaching sessions, discussion, and feedback from experienced coaches.

Wrapping Up!

With Coach Masters Academy, your MCC credential journey becomes truly transformational, enabling you to foster profound change in clients. You will develop the skills necessary to move clients from confusion to clarity, from hesitation to action, and from indecisiveness to growth.

Upon completion of the program, you will be able to artfully demonstrate key behaviors and competencies that are required for coaching mastery and can apply for an ICF MCC credential.

Key Takeaways from CMA’s Advance and Mastery Coaching Certification

16 Oct

Key Takeaways from CMA’s Advance and Mastery Coaching Certification

Coaching as a profession has turned into a big industry. It has grown into a competitive landscape where continual learning and expanding skillsets become crucial to stay ahead of the curve. Being a coach is a job full of responsibilities and full-time commitment. As people seek coaching for guidance, accountability, and support to achieve their personal and professional growth, you must have all the necessary skills to assist them in that journey successfully.

Coach Masters Academy allows you to take your coaching career to the next level through its advanced online coaching certification courses. Basically, it is Advance and Mastery Coaching Certification Training for PCC and MCC that takes you on the path of deep transformation. Coaching engagement between a coach and the client encourages sustainable transformation, expressed as deep and lasting change. Thus, to make this happen, coaches must develop a strong connection and grounded presence with their clients, allowing them to draw from within.

There are two distinct training levels specially designed for coaches at different levels of their professional development.

Advanced Training for Mastery Coaching

It’s a 70-hour online coaching training course approved for Level 2 accreditation. This program completion results in Advance Professional Coach Certification, suitable for those seeking to apply for the PCC Credential.

This advanced training is built on CMA’s proprietary framework Awareness-Clarity-Choice Conversation helps accelerate your competency to create a more meaningful and deep conversation. You will learn how transformative moments unfold and deepen the learning for clients. Moreover, you will acquire the skills to facilitate and navigate a dynamic coaching process that invites change.

Mastery Training for Artful Coaching 

This is an ICF-approved, 100 percent online coaching course of 80 hours that integrates the science of deep coaching. This course satisfies the ICF Level 3 Accreditation, which means upon completing the course you will obtain Master Coach Certification, making you eligible to apply for the MCC Credential.

Coaches looking to deepen their understanding of change and evoke more profound transformational shifts can enroll in this online coaching certification course. Built on CMA’s Awareness-Clarity-Choice Conversation framework, this program will prepare you to coach people for intentional change.

Besides these transformational lasting results, the Advance and Mastery Coaching Certification Training for PCC and MCC offers many more benefits.

Here are the five key takeaways from the course.

1.   Master Self-Assessment and Core Competency at PCC to MCC Levels

The course emphasizes the importance of self-awareness and continuous self-assessment. As a coach, you will learn how to assess your own performance. You become able to identify your areas for improvement while recognizing your strengths. When you are looking ahead to artfully demonstrate your core competencies, self-assessment becomes integral to your coaching career. By honing these skills, you can facilitate transformative conversations that resonate on a deeper level during client engagements.

2.   Advanced Skills in Establishing a Coaching Agreement

A strong coaching relationship begins with a clear, mutual understanding between the coach and the client. CMA’s advanced coaching courses guide you in developing advanced skills to establish a full and effective coaching agreement. Upon completion of your training, you will be able to create agreements that align with your client’s goals and expectations, setting the stage for meaningful and productive coaching sessions.

3.   Transformative Coaching Principles and Techniques

CMA’s certification programs are focused on the exploration and application of transformative coaching principles. You will dive deep into techniques that go beyond surface-level change, focusing on methods that support sustainable and in-depth transformation. These advanced principles are designed to help you facilitate profound self-discovery and learning in your clients, helping them achieve the lasting positive change they want.

4.   Synthesize Skills to Enhance Your Unique Coaching Style

One of the most valuable aspects of CMA’s online coach training course is the opportunity to combine your skills, styles, and strengths into a cohesive and unique coaching approach. The course encourages you to expand your capacity for evocative directness—engaging with clients in a way that is both powerful and gentle, challenging yet supportive. You will also develop a systemic orientation, enabling you to view your clients’ challenges from a broader perspective and help them achieve generative change.

5.   Global Interaction and Perspective

The online coaching certification course by CMA offers an unparalleled chance to interact with a diverse group of coaches worldwide. This global interaction advances your learning experience, exposing you to different coaching styles, cultural perspectives, and approaches. Engaging with an international community of coaches not only broadens your perspective but also positions you as a professional with a global mindset.

Conclusion

The Coach Masters Academy’s Advance and Mastery Coaching Certification course is more than just a credentialing program—it’s an immersive experience that equips you with the skills, knowledge, and mindset necessary to excel in the competitive coaching industry. By focusing on deep transformation, advanced techniques, and global perspectives, this certification prepares you to create meaningful, lasting change in your clients’ lives.

Things have gotten even better with online coaching training programs that offer the essential skillset and core understanding of the engagement process. However, when pursuing coach training, it is crucial to choose a program with high standards, a proven methodology, and global recognition.

CMA is at the forefront of a transformative coaching program that integrates the proprietary Awareness-Clarity-Choice Conversation to heighten awareness and deepen learning. Through CMA’s coaching training course online programs, you can learn all these values and skills. Meanwhile, here are three main elements of coaching courses that you must know. Read on to find out.

Coaching is Not about Fixing Problems

Coaching isn’t about fixing the wrong things; it’s about pushing boundaries to achieve new levels of success. As a coach, you need to define and achieve meaningful goals, enabling your clients to tap into the wealth of skills they may not have realized they had. Through CMA’s unique Awareness-Clarity-Choice methodology, coaching transforms the way you view challenges and enables you to harness your full potential.

At CMA, you will learn to help clients clarify their aspirations, design actionable goals, and hold themselves accountable.

Coaching Remains Confidential

A key aspect of effective coaching is confidentiality. The trust between coach and client fosters a safe space where they can openly express thoughts, doubts, and aspirations without fear of judgment. At CMA, we emphasize the importance of maintaining client privacy and following industry-leading ethical standards like those of the International Coaching Federation (ICF). This assurance of privacy enables genuine conversations that pave the way for real growth and transformation.

Final Words!

Choosing the right coaching certification online is key to starting a rewarding career, setting you on a path toward a fulfilling, impactful career. Coach Masters Academy stands out for anyone serious about professional coaching. With CMA’s coaching program online, you not only gain critical skills but also a deep understanding of transformative coaching methods that help clients achieve real, lasting changes. So, if you are ready to start a career that empowers you and your clients, CMA is the ideal place to start your journey.

Understanding CMA’s Awareness-Clarity-Choice Framework: The Science behind Transformative Coaching

7 Nov

Understanding CMA’s Awareness-Clarity-Choice Framework: The Science behind Transformative Coaching

In the vast landscape of coaching education, Coach Masters Academy (CMA) stands out as the premium choice for an online coach training program. The validation comes from CMA’s proprietary transformative coaching framework that not only helps you obtain the essential skills but expands your thinking capacity for deeper reflection. The online coaching training certificate programs enable a powerful shift in perspective and facilitate successful change transformation.

Coach Masters Academy’s online coaching programs are based on a scientific approach that combines the science of positive psychology with advanced adult learning theories creating a unique framework that applies to a wide range of coaching contexts.

CMA’s proprietary Awareness-Clarity-Choice (ACC) framework emerges as a powerful tool for facilitating sustainable transformation. This robust framework is backed by science with best practices that enhance your credibility to achieve better outcomes. The coaching conversation is a reflective inquiry process that encourages people to reflect deeper to gain greater awareness, clarity, and understanding.

Understanding the Awareness-Clarity-Choice Framework

At its core, the ACC framework is a conversational model that guides clients through a structured process of self-discovery and decision-making. The framework consists of three key stages: Awareness, Clarity, and Choice. Let’s discuss them one by one.

1.   Awareness: Understanding What Happened

The deep conversation starts with the Awareness framework which focuses on ‘what happened’. At this initial stage, transition occurs from a reactive to a receptive state of mind. This shift is crucial as it allows for gaining an objective understanding of the situation. Instead of reacting impulsively, you will learn to pause, reflect, and observe their thoughts and emotions. This phase is about expanding the mind, determining the focus, and setting the foundation for deeper exploration.

2.   Clarity: Identifying What Really Matters

Once awareness is achieved, the next step is Clarity. At this stage, you will uncover the underlying factors that truly matter to your clients. It’s about cutting through the noise and aligning their intentions with their actions. This stage is where clients discover the insights that guide their decisions, ensuring that they are not just reacting to their circumstances but making informed, purposeful choices.

3.   Choice: Deciding What’s Next

The final stage is Choice, where you will design a support structure that empowers your clients to act courageously and stay true to their commitments. This phase is crucial for translating insights into action. It involves creating accountability mechanisms that help clients follow through on their decisions, ensuring that the change is not just theoretical but tangible and sustainable.

The Science of Positive Change

What sets CMA’s Awareness-Clarity-Choice (ACC) framework apart is its foundation in scientific research and advanced adult learning theories. The framework integrates the principles of positive psychology, which focuses on enhancing well-being and harnessing individual strengths to achieve optimal functioning. This scientific approach is combined with practical fieldwork, ensuring that the coaching process is not only effective but also grounded in real-world applications.

By incorporating positive psychology, the ACC framework focuses on a strengths-based approach to coaching. Rather than focusing solely on problems or deficits, coaches help clients identify and leverage their inherent strengths. This approach fosters resilience, self-efficacy, and a positive mindset, all of which are essential for driving lasting change.

Wrapping Up!

Coach Masters Academy’s proprietary Awareness-Clarity-Choice framework is more than just a coaching tool; it’s a pathway to sustainable change. By guiding clients through a structured process of awareness, clarity, and choice, the framework empowers them to make informed decisions, take meaningful action, and achieve lasting transformation, which is at the core of transformative coaching engagements. For coaches, it offers a scientifically grounded, versatile approach that enhances their ability to effect positive change in any context.

In an industry where the ability to adapt and innovate is key, CMA’s ACC framework stands out as a method that not only meets the current demands of coaching but also sets the standard for future practices. Through its blend of science and practical application, it drives the kind of sustainable change that is the hallmark of transformative coaching.

title: Classic Definition of what is Coaching-Coach Masters Academy
content:
Here is a collection of classic definition of coaching by leading Professional Coaches

Coaching involves dialogue between a coach and a client with the aim of helping the client obtain a fulfilling life. This is achieved by helping the client establish what is important to them and by clarifying their values. With the client’s input the coach co-creates value based goals and a plan to achieve them. Through collaboration, the coach supports the client to achieve these goals. International Coaching Academy

Coaching is a process that enables learning and development to occur and thus performance to improve. To be a successful a coach requires a knowledge and understanding of process as well as the variety of styles, skills and techniques that are appropriate to the context in which coaching takes place. Eric Parsloe

Coaching is about performing at your best through the individual and private assistance of someone who will challenge, stimulate and guide you to keep growing. Gerard O’Donovan

Coaching is a way of working with people that leaves them more competent and more fulfilled so that they are more able to contribute to their organizations and find meaning in what they are doing. James Flaherty

Coaching will help you to discover how to unlock the many inner resources that lie dormant and unused in you because you fail to recognize that they are there. Carmel Wynne

Coaching is about helping the client to think of things from a different perspective. It is helping a person achieve more from the depths of their being than they would otherwise have been able. Shirley Caldwell
Coaching is not telling people what to do; it’s giving them a chance to examine what they are doing in light of their intensions. James Flaherty

Coaching involves holding out a possibility in front of others while coaching them to move to the next level of relentless compassion. Robert Hargrove

Coaching helps individuals to be aware of their strengths as well as their weakness and to decide on a course of action best suited to their goals. It is a process consisting of focused conversations to create an environment for individual growth, purposeful action and sustained improvement.

Coaching is a development process that enables clients to build their capabilities so that they can achieve personal, professional and organization goals. Coaches partner with their client in a thought-provoking and creative process that inspires clients to maximize their personal and professional potential.

A linguistic approach to define the coaching profession in a short and precise sentence by Alain Cardon, MCC

title: COACHING: EMPOWERING CHOICE-Coach Masters Academy
content:
Phil Sandahl, CPCC, is an international coach and coaching trainer with The Coaches Training Institute.

Imagine this scenario: One morning you decide that this is the day to leave home. You want to be someplace else. You walk out the front door, go down to the street and, at your front door, you make your first choice: do you go left or right? Actually, it’s your second choice — your first was to decide to leave home. However, you really don’t need a coach to help you decide whether to turn right or left; you could just as easily flip a coin, follow a hunch or ask a passing stranger.

So what’s coaching and why is it becoming part of the mainstream? In its simplest form, coaching has emerged over the last 15 years or so because it assists people in getting where they want to go more efficiently and effectively and, in the process, they learn a new way to “travel.” It’s important to note that nobody needs a coach; not the way one needs food, clothing, shelter or healing from injury or pain. 

Coaching is an additive that:

  • Clarifies direction and destination
  • Unleashes potential and resources
  • Accelerates progress
  • Removes obstacles
  • Builds bridges

Coaching could help you decide where you specifically wanted to get to when you leave home. While “anywhere” may qualify, you’d no doubt have to make quite a few trials before you find the destination that fits. It is a process of imagining, clarifying and choosing. Coaching helps you draw the map and select the mode of transportation. And the “you” could be an individual, a team or an organization.

Let’s take organizations as an example. These days, people in an organization can connect via cell phone and share information just about anywhere in the world, any time of the day or night. Imagine for a moment that we were suddenly transported back to the days of the pony express.

Decision-making could only move as fast as the average palomino over rough terrain. All right the analogy is extreme, but the notion is that coaching creates a context for decision-making in an organization where efficiency is the goal. It promotes clarity while reducing backtracking, second-guessing or wandering aimlessly in dead-end canyons. Coaching individuals within an organization has a similar impact — people can become focused, energized and effective.

The same applies for individuals and teams. Coaching helps people determine their destination and gives them an incentive to stay on course to get there. In today’s business world, organizations need every advantage they can find to be more adept, more agile, more focused in order to achieve the results they need to survive and thrive. For individuals, the desire may be to live life more fully by their own unique definition. It might be a more satisfying career, material well-being, stronger relationships — the goals may vary, but the underlying process is essentially the same. Coaching helps leverage time, talent and resources to make the most of this day, this opportunity, this life.

The process of coaching involves an ongoing relationship where coach and client/coachee are companions and partners assisting the client in the client’s journey. Clients determine the goals; coaches bring the tools of their trade. The tools come in a variety of shapes and sizes, different names and applications, but in one way or another the appropriate application can help people find and stay the course.

What makes coaching unique is the nature of the conversation between coach and client. In most other professional relationships there is power or authority given to the provider. Coaching facilitates a peer relationship where both client and coach can give 100 percent to the work for the sake of the client, while being equal in power and authority and working together to get the client to the desired destination. At its best, this approach changes the nature of the conversation: coach and client create a new form of open, engaged, truth telling. The result is empowering and authentic.

Coaching works. A decade or more of evidence supports that. It works because individuals, teams and organizations are able clarify choices, become aware when they are off track, and move forward effectively. It works because coaching creates empowered relationships and the ability to improve connections and achieve potential.

Coaching is an energetic profession that seems to release energy in others as a by product of the work. These days, coaches are helping clients draw extraordinary maps and build the bridges necessary to make their vision come alive. Nice work if you can get it

Remember those time before they were born, when many of us brought books, attended courses or asked more experienced parents to learn about parenting? Why not do it NOW? Here is a parenting workshop that introduces how coaching skill can help you transform your parenting challenges into joys and how together, you can help your teens discover their potential for a successful life.

The teenage years have been referred to as the age of raging hormonal imbalance. This is not an easy time for parents, but it is probably harder for the teenagers. They are torn between insecurity and the need for acceptance by peers. They are uncertain about what they want and may seem to drift away from parents. Despite this difficult relationship, teenagers need their parents to show love and acceptance to them, and to guide them more than ever.

More than anything else, parents also want to help their teenagers grow into healthy, happy adults. However, most parents have failed to understand they need to change their approach when working with teenagers. Parents continue to use discredited discipline techniques even though they can see that they are not effective. There is no improvement and it hurts the relationship.

TIME for a Positive Change!

Change the way you relate with your teenagers and bring out the best in them.

How can a coaching approach help you to relate better with your teenagers? Coaching is a term mostly applied to sports. It is about athletes performing their best with the assistance of a coach who will challenge, stimulate and guide them to keep growing. In many ways, developing a coaching relationship with your teenager is parallel to sport coaching.

Our approach is to foster a collaborative partnership that will enable parents to help their teenagers discover who they are and what really matters most to them. In the security of a loving and supportive home environment, parents can help their teens discover and realize their potential.

Incorporate coaching skills in your parenting style and experience the differences.

We believe that better parenting skills can be learned but it is not a quick fix magic formula, and certainly not a one-minute-a-day program that promises effortless solutions to the complex challenges of parenting. It is like physical wellness program where there skills should be applied day after day, and year after year. to build strong minds and characters. These skills represent the best positive intervention for parents who have the courage to transform their problematic teenagers to healthy, happy adults.

What you can gain from this 1 Day Workshop?

  • Transform your thinking about parenting: Gain a new identity as a Coaching-Parent and learn to see your teenagers through different eyes
  • Learn how to ask good questions to build strong relationships and help your teenagers think responsibly for themselves
  • Apply a proven parenting-coaching model that will help you create a supportive and loving home environment where your teenagers can thrive.

An African proverb says, “It takes a village to raise a child” because parents cannot do it alone.

Today, modern life makes parenting even more challenging: the pressures long working hours, stress, and the ever increasing standard of living causes family breakup to rise to crisis levels. Today, as parents, we need all the help we can get, not for our own sakes but for that of the children. We need to learn how to show love despite frustrations in a way that is accepting and empowering for both parents and teenagers. We want to do this to give them more hope and possibilities for their lives than we had in ours.

Fortunately, parents today can benefit from learning to apply modern studies on behavior to raise their teenagers. Just like how it takes a “village” – different people and ideas – to raise a child or teenager well, this workshop has been specifically designed with proven techniques drawn from the latest development on positive psychology.

This is all with the aim to effect affirmative changes in your relationship with your teenager. The workshop will help you apply these skills in simple, effective and practical ways. By experimenting and practicing with the techniques, you will quickly find yourself becoming an effective parenting-coach.

Email us today at info@iamlifecoach.com to explore how you can organize this life-transformative workshop.
